title: Norm of a homogenized affine form
statement: Let $a_0\in\mathbb R$ and let $a=(a_i)_{i=1}^n\in\mathbb R^n$. The uniform $L^2$ norm of the linear form on the $(n+1)$-dimensional sign cube with coefficients $(a_0,a_1,\ldots,a_n)$ equals the uniform $L^2$ norm of the affine form $a_0+\sum_{i=1}^n a_i x_i$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube.
hypotheses_covered: A real coefficient vector indexed by Fin n
